## About
Steele Auto Body is a family-owned collision repair shop in Oakdale, serving Pittsburgh and the surrounding area. Our goal is simple: a friendly, professional place to get your car fixed right and back on the road safely.
We do collision repair, dent removal, painting, glass replacement and frame straightening. We keep you updated while your vehicle is with us, give you transparent pricing, and stand behind our workmanship for as long as you own the car.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 115 Google reviews. We'd be glad to take care of you too.

## Services
- Collision repair and refinishing: Repairing accident damage and refinishing your vehicle, including painting and frame straightening.
- Paintless dent repair: Removing minor dents and dings without disturbing the original paint finish.
- Glass replacement: Removing damaged glass, cleaning the area and installing new glass to manufacturer's standards.
- Insurance claims: We guide you through the claim, communicate with your provider and document repairs the way they require.
- Vehicle transport: If your vehicle can't be driven, we'll get it safely to our shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with insurers such as Erie, State Farm, Travelers, AAA and Nationwide to help the repair go smoothly.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on the damage, the repairs needed and parts availability. We'll send you repair updates while your vehicle is at our shop.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: Cost depends on the extent of the damage, the parts and materials needed and the labor involved. We always give you transparent pricing information.

Q: Do you offer a warranty?
A: Yes. Our workmanship is warrantied for as long as you own the vehicle, and parts carry the manufacturer's warranty. If you have any issue, bring it back and we'll make it right.
